metric_definitions.decision_cpu_seconds: Sum of per-trial time.process_time() spent inside run_method for the sealed confirmatory payloads. Not wall-clock. Not full-process CPU of a later replay.
metric_definitions.full_cpu_seconds: Sum of per-trial decision_cpu_seconds from a --full replay, or process CPU of that invocation when recorded separately
metric_definitions.wall_clock_seconds: perf_counter elapsed time of a specific invocation

sealed_confirmatory.note: Sealed decision CPU is 437.59375 s = 0.122 h. Do not report 0.112 CPU-h or 402.0 CPU-s for this metric. A later --full replay on one machine used ~404 s wall-clock; dividing that wall-clock by 3600 yields ~0.112 h and is a different quantity.
